title: Cadaver
description: Your corpse is left behind when you die, safely containing all of your items!
body:
Cadaver

> _Your corpse is left behind when you die, safely containing all of your items!_ This datapack makes your body drop on the ground when you die. It will stay there until you rick-click on it, which will grant you your items back, putting them in their original slots if possible (otherwise dropping them on the ground). Other players cannot take your items, nor can they otherwise break or move your cadaver. ## Warning **This datapack only supports Vanilla inventories!** That means you'll lose all of your items if you put them in Curios, Trinkets, or other modded inventories/slots! ## Installation 1. Simply grab `§5Cadaver.zip` from here (Modrinth) _OR_ from [the latest GitHub release](https://github.com/DatBogie/Cadaver/releases/latest) by clicking the big "Download Here" button and put it into your world's `datpacks` folder! 2. You can configure the datapack by running `/function cadaver:config` (requires OP). ## Compatibility - Cadaver doesn't support *any* modded inventories or inventory slots. - Cadaver doesn't fully support *any* custom dimensions! The cadaver will still spawn and work, but the Cadaver Compass won't point the right direction, and will say it's in an "Unknown" dimension. - Additionally, this datapack was made for and tested on version `26.1.1`, but should work on past/future `26.1.X` versions (and potentially `26.X.X`, too). It *should* also work on `>=1.21.9` versions, but I guarantee no support! ## License This datapack is licensed under the [MIT license](https://github.com/DatBogie/Cadaver/blob/main/LICENSE). I encourage anyone to use this as a base to create their own datapacks! That is, if you can read my awful code ;) ## Issues Please submit any issues/bugs you encouter over on [GitHub](https://github.com/DatBogie/Cadaver/issues)! Please try not to submit duplicates :)         *Side-note: This is my first time uploading something to Modrinth. If I'm doing something wrong, please let me know! :)*
